howto_md:
## How to use this booklet

This booklet is a map of sewing, one of the four Needle Arts on Curious Sparoows (with Crochet, Knitting and Embroidery). Every entry tells you, in one or two lines, what a machine, tool, technique or garment is. Every entry has an ID (such as SEW-07.1 for darts) that is also its address on the website.

- **Parts** are the big branches; **Sections** (SEW-01, SEW-02...) are the main topics.
- **Entries** carry a ☐ box: tick it when you have learned or made it.
- **Registers** give 24 garments with level, fabric, pieces, techniques and time, and a history timeline.
- Start with **Part 0**, five two-minute questions.
howto_intro: This booklet is a map of sewing: machines, tools and materials, techniques, pattern making, garments, quilting and mending, history, people, ideas and a practical guide.
Every entry has an ID (such as SEW-07.1 for darts). The same ID is the entry's address on curioussparoows.com.
howto_boxes: **Parts 0 to 12:** intro questions, map, machines, tools and materials, techniques, pattern making, registers, beyond garments, history and people, ideas, practical guide, reviews, navigation and sources.
**Entries (☐):** one or two lines each; tick when learned or made.
**Step 2.** Learn your machine and its parts (Part 2).
**Step 3.** Make the first 10 projects in order (Part 10).
**Step 4.** Pick one garment from the register and fit it to yourself.
**Step 5.** Tick ☐ and keep a sewing log.

Knowledge belongs to the people who created it. Patterns are described, never copied; designers, tailors and karigars are credited. Where something could not be verified, we say so instead of guessing.
